title: NACK repair and FEC boundary
summary: NORM reliability is a transport guarantee below SocketProvider and must not be confused with semantic commit or application acknowledgement.
invariants: NACK/FEC repair answers transport completeness; semantic acceptance, authority and durable commit remain upper-layer concerns.

The dev3 forcing case used induced 10 percent sender loss with paritySymbols=0 and reconstructed the exact 520000-byte object, providing evidence of NACK/retransmission repair rather than proactive parity.
qualificationTxLossPercent is qualification-only metadata mapped to NormSetTxLoss and is not application policy.
NormDataEnqueue backing storage remains alive until NORM object purge because libnorm retains the application buffer for the transport object's lifetime.
